goal: Make the DemoPilot flow explicit as intent -> acceptance -> result, and use the authenticated local Codex CLI as the iteration provider
acceptance: User can choose or enter boundary, priority, acceptance criteria, and constraints before generation
Run stores a one-page intent statement and visible acceptance evidence
codex_cli provider can run every Agent Team stage through codex exec --json without writing files
Builder, Runner, and Reviewer still provide deterministic and browser evidence; revision loops remain bounded
Mock regression suite and Codex CLI smoke path pass

subtasks.task: Define and persist intent statement fields
subtasks.reason: Pydantic schema is deterministic; wording and defaults follow the article and require product judgment
subtasks.handoff_condition: If the user needs different choice dimensions, keep the current fields and route the change to human review
subtasks.acceptance_or_eval: Intent statement contains goal, boundary, priority, acceptance, constraints and source inputs

subtasks.reason: Subprocess invocation, JSONL parsing, timeout and error handling are deterministic
subtasks.handoff_condition: Missing auth, timeout, invalid JSON or nonzero exit must fail the run visibly and never fall back silently
subtasks.acceptance_or_eval: Valid JSON object returned for a brief call; no file writes

subtasks.task: Expose intent, acceptance and result in the Vue workflow
subtasks.reason: UI layout and choice wording need human-readable judgment; state transitions and rendering are testable
subtasks.handoff_condition: Visual polish and customer-specific sales wording remain human review
subtasks.acceptance_or_eval: Submit requires confirmed intent; selected run shows acceptance and evidence-bound result

subtasks.reason: Existing tests, lint, build and local services are deterministic
subtasks.handoff_condition: Browser rendering or model availability failures remain explicitly unverified
subtasks.acceptance_or_eval: All required checks pass or are labeled blocked/not-run

human_review: final wording and visual hierarchy of the intent card
whether generated demo is persuasive for a real customer
whether any acceptance criterion is commercially or legally sufficient
fail_closed: Codex CLI auth or availability failure
no silent Mock fallback for codex_cli
